security_audit.summary: The static command, filesystem, and network findings are documentation examples or local Burp setup values, not executable skill behavior. No prompt injection text was found. The skill is dual-use security guidance and needs tighter guardrails for destructive checkout testing and credential attack workflows.

remediation.suggestion: Change the example to stop at evidence collection in a sandbox. State that real purchases or account changes require explicit test-system approval.
Add local Intruder guardrails for written authorization, test accounts, strict rate limits, and no production credential lists.
Label path traversal and command injection payloads as controlled-test examples. Prefer benign marker files or mock targets when possible.

content.user_title: Test Web Apps with Burp Suite
content.value_statement: Web application testing can miss issues when traffic review and replay steps are unstructured. This skill provides authorized Burp Suite workflows for interception, Repeater testing, scope control, scanning, and reporting.
actual_capabilities: Configures Burp proxy workflows for browser traffic interception.
Explains how to review HTTP history and filter target scope.
Guides request modification for parameter and business logic testing.
Uses Repeater to replay requests and compare responses.
Describes Professional scanner setup and issue review.
Outlines Intruder payload positions and result analysis.
limitations: Requires Burp Suite and a browser configured for proxy traffic.
Automated scanning applies only to Burp Suite Professional.
Does not replace authorization, test planning, or legal approval.
Does not validate findings without user review and evidence.

use_cases.title: Run an Authorized Web Assessment
use_cases.description: Set scope, intercept traffic, replay suspicious requests, and document confirmed vulnerabilities.

use_cases.title: Validate Risky Parameters
use_cases.description: Check price, quantity, ID, and hidden fields before release in a controlled test environment.

use_cases.title: Review Scan Evidence
use_cases.description: Use Burp scanner output and manual review steps to prioritize remediation with developers.

prompt_templates.title: Configure the Proxy
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me configure Burp Suite to intercept traffic for an authorized test site. Include browser setup, proxy settings, and certificate checks.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze HTTP History
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through reviewing Burp HTTP history for my in-scope application. Focus on parameters, authentication flows, and response anomalies.

prompt_templates.title: Test a Parameter in Repeater
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a safe Repeater workflow for testing one in-scope request parameter. Include payload selection, response comparison, and evidence notes.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Scoped Burp Assessment
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a Burp Suite test plan for an authorized web app. Include scope setup, scanner settings, Intruder limits, and reporting steps.

output_examples.input: I need to test a checkout flow for client-side price trust.
output: Confirm written authorization and use a test environment.
Capture the checkout request and identify client-supplied price fields.
Change one value in a controlled test and compare the server response.
Document whether the server recalculates price before order creation.

output_examples.input: Help me review Burp scanner results.
output_examples.output: The skill would separate likely findings from scanner noise, collect request and response evidence, and draft clear remediation notes.

output_examples.input: Set up Repeater testing for an ID parameter.
output_examples.output: The skill would send the request to Repeater, change one value at a time, compare responses, and record access-control evidence.

best_practices: Get written authorization and define scope before intercepting or scanning traffic.
Use test accounts and non-production data for destructive or high-impact checks.
Keep Burp scope filters enabled to avoid testing unrelated domains.
anti_patterns: Running Intruder or scanner against public systems without approval.
Completing real purchases or account changes during business logic testing.
Treating automated scanner output as confirmed vulnerability evidence.

faq.question: Does this skill install Burp Suite?
faq.answer: No. It assumes Burp Suite is already installed and focuses on testing workflows.

faq.question: Can it be used with Burp Community Edition?
faq.answer: Yes. Proxy and Repeater guidance applies, but automated scanning requires Professional.

faq.question: Does it perform attacks automatically?
faq.answer: No. It explains Burp workflows and requires the user to operate tools within authorized scope.

faq.question: How should I handle credentials?
faq.answer: Use approved test accounts and avoid collecting production secrets unless the engagement permits it.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, or Claude Code use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should reports include?
faq.answer: Include affected URLs, requests, responses, impact, reproduction steps, and remediation guidance.
